name: Válor (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Válor (a crown, a crescent and crossed scimitars on blue).
history: Válor adopted its arms and flag officially on 13 March 2001; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three equal vertical stripes, blue, white and blue, with the municipal arms at the centre.
